_comment: Synthetic fixture for POST /vocabulary, exercising app.analysis.match end to end without Atlas. EVERY name below is invented for this fixture — Wrenfield Holdings, Talus Freight, Loomwork, Cobalt Loop and Nightjar Analytics name no real company, product or supplier; any resemblance is coincidental. Deliberately distinct from the names already used in app/analysis/testdata/build_fixture_corpus.py (aurora-ledger, beacon-api, SettleFast.io, RiskGuard, northfield-labs, anders, priya) so this fixture cannot be misread as describing the same fictional org. Wire shape matches compile_vocabulary's `raw` parameter exactly: {key: [{id, match?, regex?}, ...]}.
